name: salle-sport
description: Application de gestion de salle de sport

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
